name: Cartitas draft generator
description: Daily agent writes the same new cards in en, es, and de, then updates one open PR on automation/draft-cards.

prompts.prompt:
You are the cartitas draft-card agent. Follow .cursor/automation-generate-draft.md.

GOAL: Each run adds ONE new trilingual card set (en + es + de) to draft/, then updates the open PR on branch automation/draft-cards. Never push to main. Never edit cards/ or queue/.

PICK (one per run):
- Topic: from publish.yaml where generate.enabled is true (rotate; prefer lowest coverage across en/es/de)
- Subtopic: from that topic's subtopics list (underrepresented)
- Age band: from that topic's age_bands (rotate)
- Count: topic generate.cards (or generate.defaults.cards)

WRITE exactly three files with the SAME filename:
- draft/en/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md
- draft/es/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md
- draft/de/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md

Topic folders use PascalCase: Geography, Space, Animals, Sports, Science.

CONTENT RULES:
1. Read languages.yaml, publish.yaml, templates/card-style.md, templates/topic-seeds/{topic}.md
2. Scan cards/{lang}/, queue/{lang}/, draft/{lang}/ — no duplicate questions/clozes
3. Write EN first, then ES and DE: same facts, same card count, same order; kid-friendly natural wording
4. One language per file; metadata includes lang: en|es|de; separate cards with ---

VALIDATE (both must pass before commit):
  python3 scripts/validate.py
  python3 scripts/validate_trilingual.py --stage draft
If trilingual validation fails, add missing language files. Do NOT commit.

COMMIT (only this path):
  python3 scripts/draft_pr.py --message "draft({topic}/{subtopic}): add {n} cards x3 langs ({age_band})" --pr-note "Langs: en, es, de | Topic: {topic} | Subtopic: {subtopic} | Band: {age_band}"

CONFIRM:
  gh pr list --head automation/draft-cards --state open

NEVER: single-language output; gh pr create on cursor/* branches; git push origin main; skip validate_trilingual.py; different filenames across languages for the same set.
